prompt:
You are the Failure-Lens Proposer. From only the general task seed and the fixed goal of producing an implementable requirements handoff, propose 3-5 distinct externally observable ways discovery, interaction, synthesis, handoff, implementation, verification, or learning can fail. Do not propose solutions or skill wording and do not name or compare products, agents, skills, or frameworks.
Return only the JSON object required by the supplied output schema.
INPUT:
{"fixed_goal":"surface material ambiguity and produce an implementable requirements handoff","seed_category":"Specify an export command for a personal notes application that can emit selected notes for offline archiving while preserving metadata and reporting partial failures."}

input.seed_category: Specify an export command for a personal notes application that can emit selected notes for offline archiving while preserving metadata and reporting partial failures.
input.fixed_goal: surface material ambiguity and produce an implementable requirements handoff

lenses.failure_description: The requirements do not establish which notes qualify as selected, especially when selection includes filters, folders, tags, hidden items, deleted items, or an empty result.
lenses.observable_signal: Two implementers given the same user invocation export different note sets, or the command exports notes the user did not intend to archive.
lenses.why_material: Selection determines the archive’s contents; ambiguity can cause silent omission or unintended disclosure of personal notes.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Provide a collection containing ordinary, hidden, deleted, tagged, and folder-scoped notes, then evaluate which note identifiers the handoff says must be exported for several representative selections.

lenses.failure_description: The handoff leaves the export artifact’s structure, note encoding, attachment treatment, filename rules, and metadata representation materially unspecified.
lenses.observable_signal: Independent implementations produce archives that cannot be interpreted consistently or that lose different parts of the same note.
lenses.why_material: Offline archiving requires a stable, inspectable artifact whose content and metadata remain usable outside the live application.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Use one note containing formatted text, timestamps, tags, special characters, duplicate titles, and an attachment, then determine the exact externally visible archive entries and metadata fields required by the handoff.

lenses.failure_description: Exported notes omit, alter, or conflate metadata needed to identify and reconstruct the archived records.
lenses.observable_signal: The archive shows changed timestamps, missing tags, unstable identifiers, incorrect ordering fields, or indistinguishable notes with the same title.
lenses.why_material: An archive that preserves note bodies but not reliable metadata may be insufficient for audit, recovery, migration, or deduplication.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export notes with identical titles but different identifiers, creation times, modification times, tags, and source locations, then compare each archived metadata value with its source value.

lenses.failure_description: When some notes cannot be exported, the command’s completion status and report do not clearly distinguish exported, skipped, and failed items or explain the scope of the failure.
lenses.observable_signal: The command appears successful despite missing notes, reports only a generic error, or leaves the user unable to identify which items require attention.
lenses.why_material: Partial failure is an expected boundary condition, and an ambiguous outcome can create false confidence that an offline archive is complete.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Run an export where one selected note succeeds, one is unreadable, and one attachment cannot be copied, then inspect the artifact, process status, and user-visible report for item-level outcome distinctions.

lenses.failure_description: The handoff provides no observable basis for determining whether the resulting archive is complete and internally consistent after the command finishes.
lenses.observable_signal: A missing or truncated note cannot be detected from the command outcome or archive contents without manually comparing every source record.
lenses.why_material: The fixed goal requires an implementable handoff whose success can be verified; unverifiable completeness allows silent archival loss to pass acceptance.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export a known set of notes, remove or truncate one produced entry, and assess whether the specified observable outputs allow the discrepancy to be detected.
